key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 26, 51)
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX (Headline 32)
Oil prices 'explode' as suppression fails; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c, stoking inflation fears (Headlines 21, 40)
AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern (Headlines 38, 49)
High-end housing prices see steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient (Headline 78)
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals sector stress (Headline 27)
Nvidia to expand data centre capacity in Australia, boosting AI/tech sentiment (Headline 55)
Australia softens gas supply rules; Albo 'sells out' gas reservation, easing Asian supply fears (Headlines 52, 75)

sectors.trend: Sharp deterioration. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; gold underperforming ('schmould'); cap-raise wave signals capital stress. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GSG.AX) lag. Small-cap explorers (SUN.AX, MNR.AX) offer speculative upside but carry dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Under pressure from rising bond yields and rate fears. Housing correction (high-end) raises NPL concerns. RBA rental-inflation focus complicates rate path.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk if RBA holds or hikes. Housing correction (Headline 78) is a medium-term credit risk for mortgage books.

sectors.trend: Oil surge is a double-edged sword: positive for producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SAN.AX) but negative for fuel-dependent consumers and inflation outlook. Gas policy liberalisation supports SAN.AX.
sectors.implications: Santos (SAN.AX) benefits from softened gas reservation rules. Woodside (WDS.AX) gains from oil upside but faces LNG contract headwinds. Fuel cost pass-through pressures WES.AX, CWP.AX.

sectors.trend: Stress evident: Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples; women's clothing chain closed 177 stores. Consumer squeeze from fuel and housing costs.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CWP.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Discretionary names (WOW.AX, LPX.AX) vulnerable to reduced consumer spending.

sectors.trend: Nvidia's Australian data centre expansion is a structural positive. ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) showing momentum. Cloudflare up 10.5% on upbeat guidance.
sectors.implications: Supports ASX-listed tech and infrastructure plays. AI capex cycle benefits data centre REITs and power demand.

sectors.trend: Housing correction concentrated at high end; affordable segment resilient. Rental inflation is RBA's key concern. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face mixed signals: rental upside vs. occupancy risk. Residential developers (DHG.AX, MYC.AX) benefit from first-home buyer surge.

key_themes: Oil price surge driving inflation fears and rate-hike expectations
Iron ore downturn pressuring ASX heavyweight miners
AUD weakness on growth scare; RBA caught between inflation and growth
Housing market bifurcation: high-end correction vs. affordable resilience
Mining sector capital stress and cap-raise dilution risk
AI/tech infrastructure buildout as structural growth theme
Gas policy liberalisation reshaping energy landscape
Chinese inflation spike adding global macro uncertainty

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation and RBA rate hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy producers; reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or energy
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earnings (mining, agribusiness)
Monitor bank NPL data; avoid overexposure to premium property REITs
Avoid small-cap miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flowing majors
Diversify away from China-revenue-dependent names; monitor Arctic shipping route implications

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explosion' and gas policy liberalisation support earnings for Australian energy names
Nvidia's Australian data centre expansion signals multi-year AI capex cycle

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on first-home buyer-driven developers
opportunities.rationale: Housing correction at high end is redirecting demand to affordable segment; first-home buyer surge supports volume

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Chinese inflation spike may signal demand slowdown

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk in REITs and banks
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental-inflation focus and oil-driven inflation raise rate-hike probability, pressuring valuations
Canaccord-led cap-raise wave signals sector-wide capital stress and dilution risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-driven inflation and RBA hawkish tilt cap multiples. Iron ore weakness drags miners. AUD weakness may provide partial offset for exporters. Expect volatility around RBA communications and oil prints.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and iron ore finds a floor. AI infrastructure buildout (Nvidia) and gas policy reform offer structural tailwinds. Housing correction at high end should stabilise by H2 2027. Key risk is a China demand shock amplifying commodity weakness.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and rental inflation data
Iron ore price trajectory (Chinese steel demand)
ASX mining cap-raise completion and dilution impact
watch_list: Brent crude and Australian fuel pump prices
RBA rental and CPI data releases
